name: Berberine

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A quaternary isoquinoline alkaloid extracted from several plant genera, sold as a dietary supplement and taken for glycaemic and lipid effect. It is a potent CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein inhibitor, which is the basis of its interaction burden.

systems.note: Taken for glycaemic effect via AMPK activation; the intended effect.
Also taken for LDL cholesterol reduction.
Potent CYP3A4 inhibition alters clearance of co-administered drugs; hepatic exposure is substantial.

monitors.why: The glycaemic effect it is taken for.
Interval glycaemic tracking; additive with glucose-lowering drugs.
The lipid effect it is taken for.
Substantial hepatic exposure and CYP3A4 inhibition with no approved labelling.
